summary: Camouflage nets and branches, chamfered and welded armour with bolted modules and stowage, plate-to-plate paint and battle-camera weathering, car roofs without glare, shaped helicopter tails and panelled cowlings, wet waterlines and rust runs on boats.
rationale: Geometry, surface and colour changes across many families: one matched studio sheet shows a representative of each area. Camouflage is shown on one vehicle at a seed whose crew carries it, since which vehicles are camouflaged comes from each vehicle's seed.
